summary.prose: Review corrected designs by assessing direct and indirect impact before selecting chunks. Preserve unaffected prior coverage with explicit provenance, carry unresolved findings forward, and run a fresh consistency check. Fall back to full review whenever safe reuse cannot be established. [[c8]] [[c1]]

hldContextSlice.frameworkSummary:
Choose a1: a small, design-specific background coordinator; reuse the existing LLMProvider activity-mode review session, role routing, IPC/session routing and artifact store/history. Do not generalize or migrate the working task-review coordinator. New production code belongs under a dedicated design-review subdirectory of the existing src/workflow/review boundary (proposed location, not an existing module claim). Normal insrc_review_step and daemon design-review routes delegate to it; removed claim/judge/autofix execution stays removed. [[c1]] [[c2]]

A review has one canonical subject and sequential attempts. Each attempt owns its baseline, semantic chunk plan, accepted completed results and terminal summary. Current review prompts contain policy, subject/related document paths, chunk assignment and output schema, never the artifact body. Prior feedback and impact baselines are accessible by checkpoint/history references rather than repeated full input. Read-only reviewers inspect live artifact paths and any necessary code; the daemon validates structure and completeness without inventing semantic judgments. Shared substantive policy assesses correctness against requirements/upstream designs, functional completeness, contracts and ownership/cardinality, errors/test coverage where relevant, consistency, applicable conventions, and necessary linked diagrams/UX artifacts. Report unavailable verification honestly; optional advice does not become a false blocking or unverified finding.

ownedContracts.name: Impact-selected attempt and retained coverage
ownedContracts.purpose: Make selective re-review defensible and preserve unresolved feedback and coverage provenance.
ownedContracts.interfaceSketch: interface DesignImpactAssessment { readonly baselineAttempt: number; readonly mode: 'affected_chunks' | 'full'; readonly changes: readonly string[]; readonly directChunkIds: readonly string[]; readonly indirectChunkIds: readonly string[]; readonly rationale: string; readonly uncertainReason?: string | undefined; readonly chunkMapping: readonly { readonly priorIds: readonly string[]; readonly currentIds: readonly string[]; readonly explanation: string; }[]; readonly retainedCoverage: readonly { readonly chunkId: string; readonly fromAttempt: number; readonly fromChunkId: string; readonly justification: string; }[]; readonly carriedFindingIds: readonly string[]; readonly consistencyChunkIds: readonly string[]; }

consumedContracts.name: Design review subject, policy and semantic chunk contract
consumedContracts.purpose: One minimal subject request, common substantive policy and coherent chunk plans for both reviewer parties.

consumedContracts.name: Durable review attempts, feedback and progress
consumedContracts.purpose: Persist one source of review state and expose completed feedback without a long-lived request.

consumedContracts.name: Change invalidation and bounded technical recovery
consumedContracts.purpose: Keep mutation, interruption, technical retries and user decisions distinct without losing completed work.

boundary.internal: Own reviewer-led direct/indirect impact assessment, old/new plan mapping, conservative full-review fallback, retained coverage and finding reconciliation. Its document comparison/selection implementation stays private; expose only auditable scope reasoning and provenance, not a generic dependency engine.

adjacentBoundaries.internal: Deliver the first useful normal-entrypoint review: latest-subject resolution, opposite-party execution, shared artifact-specific policy, reviewer chunk planning, sequential inspection, durable completed results, visible progress and a retrievable consolidated report. Keep prompt construction, native/controller exchange and checkpoint IO private; no shared-engine migration. Produce real narrow hosted-review evidence as well as deterministic fixtures.

Own interruption/recovery transitions, reviewed-subject monitoring, cancellation/late-response rejection, the single retry budget and user-decision pause. Native activity integration is private; callers consume recovery state/actions, not process internals. Preserve sc1/sc2 semantics and no external-file invalidation.

Own lifecycle version-aware record publication/readers, normal approval integration, history-preserving cleanup, multi-session routing qualification and final compiled/live verification. Keep cleanup fence and publication retries internal. No new review dashboard, activation state or legacy compatibility execution.

nonFunctional.performance: Initial acknowledgement and progress are model-independent short operations; target <=2 seconds on an idle local daemon, measured separately from filesystem/model time. Review calls remain sequential per review; independent subjects may run concurrently. Bound checkpoint size and payloads explicitly in LLD; reject exceeded limits without silent truncation or loss of coverage. Persist completed chunks before advancing and coalesce activity-only progress writes.
nonFunctional.security: Daemon owns state/store access. Canonical registered repo and artifact identity, no-follow bounded checkpoint reads, literal review IDs and private file modes follow existing patterns. Native review uses read-only grants with no code-task command grant. Opposite reviewer party derives from trusted host/session context and artifact metadata, not request claims. No cloud REST, trust-key service or raw reasoning/prompt archive.
nonFunctional.observability: Expose review/attempt/chunk identity, phase, elapsed times, accepted completed feedback, current technical retry count, paused reason, user-input requirement, activity/tool state and publication state. Polling observes only. Separate optional advice from findings and unavailable evidence. Controller reports progress but does not edit or resolve intermediate findings.
nonFunctional.durability: Atomic validated checkpoint snapshots and completed-chunk flushes; immutable prior attempts and idempotent history publication. Reviewer disconnect, daemon restart, publication interruption and approval cleanup have explicit recovery cases. Permanent history retains baselines/impact/feedback and technical attempt summaries, not native transcripts. Never delete a checkpoint until every attempt is preserved and approval succeeded.

api.name: DesignReviewCoordinator
api.signature: class DesignReviewCoordinator { start(input: unknown, context?: DesignStartContext): Promise<DesignReviewAcknowledgement>; exchange(input: unknown, owner: DesignControllerOwner): Promise<unknown>; }

parameters.name: input
parameters.purpose: Existing untrusted input boundary, decoded with strict DesignRequestSchemas/DesignReviewRequest before use. start decodes the positive-attempt DesignReviewStart; exchange decodes the discriminated DesignReviewRequest including the proposed impact phase. No new request alias type. [[c4]] [[c9]]

parameters.name: context
parameters.purpose: Existing exported start context: optional provider and owner; no rename or new DesignReviewerContext type. [[c4]]

parameters.name: owner
parameters.purpose: Existing exchange-only trusted connection lifetime; authority never comes from request JSON. [[c4]]

returns.meaning: Short durable acknowledgement or existing bounded exchange frame; a correction attempt starts impact analysis in the background. [[c4]]

errors.condition: Noncontiguous attempt, mismatched artifact/project, active subject, untrusted party, invalid impact scope, byte/count bounds or persistence failure. [[c1]] [[c4]] [[c5]] [[c6]] [[c9]] [[c13]]

preconditions: Initial attempt1 behaves unchanged. A subsequent start is only latest.number+1 after a terminal complete report (passed, changes_requested or incomplete), not pending/running/interrupted/paused/failed/invalidated. Recovery of an interrupted/paused attempt remains sc3; an invalidated attempt requires user-approved restart_full and never reuses coverage. [[c1]] [[c4]] [[c5]] [[c6]] [[c9]] [[c13]]

Same review/attempt replay is observe-only; conflicting identity cannot replace pinned admission. Current live subject representations must be valid. No generic Git/HEAD diff defines design scope. [[c1]] [[c4]] [[c5]] [[c6]] [[c9]] [[c13]]

These are proposed S3 behavioral extensions to existing start/exchange methods, not newly invented public wrapper interfaces. Existing unknown inputs are intentional trust boundaries, not missing schema definitions. [[c4]] [[c9]]

Admission uses three explicit branches, replacing admit()'s current single saved.submitted.attempt comparison. (1) No checkpoint: require requested attempt=1; create initial full-planning attempt and immutable submitted={artifactPath,attempt:1}. (2) Requested attempt already exists: require the original admitted artifactPath/identity and return only that attempt's saved acknowledgement (active only if it is the active generation); do not append, re-prepare or dispatch. A conflicting identity remains an error. (3) Requested attempt is latest.number+1: require no active job/subject, no uncertain failed save, and latest terminal passed/changes_requested/incomplete with a complete report matching its accepted plan, baseline and results. Reject any other ordinal/status. Crucially, branch 3 does NOT compare requested attempt N to saved.submitted.attempt=1 and never rewrites submitted. [[c4]] [[c3]]
postconditions: Append one new baseline/inventory, with prior attempts frozen. Choose the latest complete report as impact baseline only if artifact identity and reviewer party match; otherwise full review with explicit reason, no retained coverage. [[c1]] [[c4]] [[c5]] [[c6]] [[c9]] [[c13]]

Subsequent impact unit returns {plan,impact}; initial and approved restart_full use ordinary full planning, never impact reuse. Monitoring starts before impact and aborts on subject mutation. No next-attempt admission occurs automatically from polling. [[c1]] [[c4]] [[c5]] [[c6]] [[c9]] [[c13]]

In the sequential-correction branch, re-prepare current subject/context and trusted reviewer, require same canonical project/artifact identity, append exactly one fresh baseline/inventory attempt with immutable preparationKind=impact, acquire existing subject fence, and persist atomically before launch. Baseline comparison is the immediately preceding complete attempt. Previously admitted attempts, including the immediately preceding one, remain byte-for-byte frozen on this append. Save/admission failure releases the fence and dispatches nothing. Initial admission and approved restart_full set preparationKind=planning; absent preparationKind in existing checkpoints means planning. [[c4]] [[c3]]

Extend checkEvolution()'s attempt-growth guard with two disjoint allowed cases. Existing invalidated predecessor + approved matching restart_full action still permits only a full preparationKind=planning attempt and no retained coverage; preserve its existing action semantics. New ordinary correction permits a terminal complete predecessor (passed/changes_requested/incomplete) plus exactly number N+1, preparationKind=impact, matching artifact/project and a byte-identical entire prior-attempt prefix. All other growth, changed original submitted metadata, skipped attempts and replacement baselines/results reject. The impact decision itself is not required at admission; it is later accepted with the plan. Freeze preparationKind after admission. [[c3]] [[c4]]

Extend controller exchange()'s exact phase/kind dispatch table to plan/planning, impact/impact and result/chunk. The new impact request is {phase:impact,repo,reviewId,attempt,executionId,sequence,plan,impact}; define its strict schema in DesignRequestSchemas, include it in DesignRequestSchema and DESIGN_REVIEW_PHASES, and expose it through normal MCP and main-owned daemon routes. Keep owner, current attempt, execution generation, next sequence and subject checks before dispatch exactly as for plan/result. A mismatched phase/kind is invalid_phase with no accepted output. [[c4]] [[c9]]

For phase impact with kind impact, validate request.plan as a complete current plan, then request.impact against that validated plan, immutable prior history and current inventory using the SAME validator supplied to the native impact output candidate. Persist the accepted {plan,impact} pair and seal its impact reservation atomically before resolving unit.accepted/acknowledging. Exact owner/execution/sequence/input replay returns the same acceptance and never repeats work; conflicting replay rejects. Structurally valid invalid impact output retires that generation and uses sc3 retry/pause; malformed envelopes spend no retry. No plan/result branch may accept impact output. [[c4]] [[c5]] [[c9]]

Normal transport inventory is explicit: src/mcp/design-review/schema.ts derives the impact phase/input; src/daemon/design-review-rpc.ts handles both step and unary impact; src/daemon/handler-runtime.ts registers designReview.impact; src/daemon/threads/method-class.ts classifies and main-owns it; src/daemon/repo-call-audit.ts marks it modifying with required repo. These are S3 integration extensions, not a provider or threading redesign. [[c11]] [[c12]]

Same-attempt writes, separately from the append-growth guard, add preparationKind to checkEvolution()'s enumerated immutable fields: require current.preparationKind === previous.preparationKind on every save of an admitted attempt, including presence/absence. Existing missing-marker checkpoints retain that exact absence; readers treat it as planning, but saves must not backfill or switch it. Add accepted impact to the existing plan-once-set immutability checks; for an impact-kind attempt the plan/impact pair is absent together or accepted together, and neither can later change or disappear. Reject marker drift or half-pair writes with immutable_history/invalid_checkpoint before replacing bytes. [[c3]] [[c9]]

api.name: validateDesignPlan

parameters.name: input
parameters.purpose: Complete current plan proposed with impact output, not a subset plan. [[c1]] [[c4]] [[c5]] [[c6]] [[c9]] [[c13]]

parameters.name: inventory
parameters.purpose: Fresh inventory of the current DEF/HLD/LLD including relevant visuals and workflow references. [[c1]] [[c4]] [[c5]] [[c6]] [[c9]] [[c13]]

returns.meaning: Existing complete inventory/selector/dependency validation. Selection is a separate sc4 decision. [[c5]] [[c1]]

errors.condition: Unknown, duplicate, omitted or inconsistent units/chunks/dependencies; final consistency absent or not last. [[c1]] [[c4]] [[c5]] [[c6]] [[c9]] [[c13]]

postconditions: Every current inventory unit has substantive coverage; final consistency depends on all substantive chunks, including retained coverage. Changed grouping is represented explicitly, not silently treated as equivalent. [[c1]] [[c4]] [[c5]] [[c6]] [[c9]] [[c13]]

api.name: nextDesignUnit
api.signature: nextDesignUnit(attempt: DesignAttempt): { kind: 'planning' | 'impact' | 'chunk'; chunk?: DesignChunk | undefined } | undefined

parameters.name: attempt
parameters.purpose: Current attempt, accepted impact selection and fresh completed results. [[c1]] [[c4]] [[c5]] [[c6]] [[c9]] [[c13]]

returns.meaning: One unfinished unit. After a plan is accepted, derive executionOrder by filtering the full current plan in its existing dependency order to the validated selected substantive IDs plus every consistency ID. For a full or pre-S3 attempt without impact, executionOrder is the entire plan. Retained IDs never enter this vector. [[c6]] [[c1]] [[c6]] [[c1]]

errors.condition: Corrupt selection, missing provenance or fresh-results order that does not match selected execution order. [[c1]] [[c4]] [[c5]] [[c6]] [[c9]] [[c13]]

preconditions: No current plan/decision mutation after acceptance; retained coverage must not appear in completedChunks. [[c1]] [[c4]] [[c5]] [[c6]] [[c9]] [[c13]]

Validate the complete current plan first; validate selected/retained disjointness and exact coverage by ID. A retained chunk has a resolvable immutable source before it can satisfy a dependency. The full plan is never destructively shortened. [[c5]] [[c6]]

Use immutable preparationKind to choose the unplanned preparation unit: impact means correction, planning or missing marker means full planning. Do not infer this solely from number>1 because approved restart_full also creates number>1. [[c6]] [[c9]]
postconditions: Replace the existing completedChunks-vs-plan positional prefix invariant with completedChunks-vs-executionOrder: every fresh result at position i must have the unique chunkId executionOrder[i].id. Reject duplicates, out-of-order or unknown fresh results. The next work item is executionOrder[completedChunks.length]; exhaustion means fresh execution is complete, not that retained chunks were inspected again. [[c6]]

Before dispatch, each dependency in the full plan must be satisfied by an earlier accepted fresh result or validated retained-by-ID coverage. Semantic changes_requested/incomplete feedback still permits subsequent chunks as in S1. A retained dependency consumes no reservation and never appears in completedChunks. [[c1]] [[c5]] [[c6]]

For full plan [keep-A, change-B, keep-C, final], selected executionOrder is [change-B, final]. With completedChunks=[change-B], next work is final; keep-A and keep-C are resolved by provenance. Recovery recomputes the same immutable vector and never repeats change-B or reserves retained chunks. [[c6]]

Before the accepted plan+impact pair exists, an explicit correction attempt yields kind impact; initial review and approved restart_full yield planning. After acceptance, resume skips the sealed preparation unit and accepted fresh prefix without resetting sc3 counters. [[c1]] [[c6]]

api.name: reserveDesignUnit
api.signature: reserveDesignUnit(attempt: DesignAttempt, chunk?: DesignChunk, allowExtra?: boolean, recovering?: boolean, preparationKind?: 'planning' | 'impact'): string

parameters.name: attempt
parameters.purpose: Existing attempt-local durable reservation state. [[c1]] [[c4]] [[c5]] [[c6]] [[c9]] [[c13]]

parameters.name: chunk
parameters.purpose: Fresh selected chunk; absent for planning or impact. [[c1]] [[c4]] [[c5]] [[c6]] [[c9]] [[c13]]

parameters.name: allowExtra
parameters.purpose: Existing user-approved one-dispatch grant after exhaustion. [[c1]] [[c4]] [[c5]] [[c6]] [[c9]] [[c13]]

parameters.name: recovering
parameters.purpose: Existing conservative interrupted reservation handling. [[c1]] [[c4]] [[c5]] [[c6]] [[c9]] [[c13]]

parameters.name: preparationKind
parameters.purpose: Additive internal discriminator; default planning preserves S1/S2 callers. Impact uses its own unit id/phase. [[c1]] [[c4]] [[c5]] [[c6]] [[c9]] [[c13]]

returns.meaning: Fresh fenced execution generation saved before dispatch. [[c6]] [[c1]]

errors.condition: Sealed unit, exhausted budget without direction, invalid user decision or changed subject. [[c1]] [[c4]] [[c5]] [[c6]] [[c9]] [[c13]]

With chunk absent, explicit/default preparationKind disagrees with admitted attempt.preparationKind (missing stored marker means planning). This is an internal reservation/context inconsistency, not reviewer output, and is terminal/nonretryable. [[c6]] [[c9]] [[c13]]

preconditions: Use existing sc3 initial+three retry policy; no new retry subsystem. [[c1]] [[c4]] [[c5]] [[c6]] [[c9]] [[c13]]
The explicit preparationKind discriminator must agree with the admitted immutable attempt marker when chunk is absent; mismatches reject rather than reserving a different phase. [[c6]] [[c9]]
postconditions: Impact planning failures consume only impact reservations. Controller/native routes share output schema, policy, activity and recovery semantics. No fixed deadline; active tools and real model activity retain S2 behavior. [[c1]] [[c4]] [[c5]] [[c6]] [[c9]] [[c13]]

Check preparationKind agreement before mutating unit/current, counters, executionId or actions. On mismatch throw invalid_checkpoint, persist no new reservation, dispatch no provider/controller assignment, and stop the owner with a visible failed state using existing sc3 nonretry handling. Never reinterpret an impact unit as planning to recover automatically. [[c4]] [[c6]] [[c13]]

api.name: consolidateDesignReview
api.signature: consolidateDesignReview(reviewId: string, attempt: number, subject: DesignReviewSubject, contentIdentity: string, plan: DesignChunkPlan, results: readonly DesignChunkResult[], impactContext?: { impact: DesignImpactAssessment; attempts: readonly DesignAttempt[]; findingDecisions: readonly DesignFindingDecision[] }): DesignReviewConsolidated

parameters.name: reviewId, attempt, subject, contentIdentity, plan, results
parameters.purpose: Current complete plan and fresh selected results; old all-fresh calls remain unchanged. [[c1]] [[c4]] [[c5]] [[c6]] [[c9]] [[c13]]

parameters.name: impactContext
parameters.type: Impact context with immutable source attempts and final finding dispositions
parameters.purpose: Validate retained origins, effective coverage and finding lineage without copying prior feedback as fresh. [[c1]] [[c4]] [[c5]] [[c6]] [[c9]] [[c13]]

returns.meaning: Counts/status over fresh and retained effective coverage plus carried unresolved findings; exposes provenance and resolved/superseded dispositions. [[c5]] [[c1]]

errors.condition: Missing fresh selected result, unknown/mismatched origin, duplicate effective coverage, unresolved finding omitted, invalid resolution or changed baseline. [[c1]] [[c4]] [[c5]] [[c6]] [[c9]] [[c13]]

preconditions: Final consistency is newly reviewed. Every current chunk is exactly fresh or explicitly retained. Known earlier findings, including LOW and incomplete coverage limitations, must be accounted for. [[c1]] [[c4]] [[c5]] [[c6]] [[c9]] [[c13]]

Retention eligibility is validated when accepting impact and revalidated at consolidation: each referenced effective source chunk, including every backward provenance link, must have status passed or changes_requested and an empty limitations array. An incomplete result is accepted historical feedback but is not reusable verified coverage. Its corresponding current chunk must be selected for fresh review, even if selectors and text are unchanged. A report that is incomplete only because of other chunks does not disqualify a complete source chunk. Do not bypass an incomplete immediately preceding mapped chunk by citing an older passed result. [[c1]] [[c5]] [[c9]]
postconditions: No unresolved earlier HIGH/MED disappears by selection, full fallback, rename or omission. Dispositions carry/resolved/superseded name immutable source tuples and evidence; resolving a finding requires fresh selected inspection and final confirmation. [[c1]] [[c4]] [[c5]] [[c6]] [[c9]] [[c13]]
Optional execution omissions stay advice; mandatory evidence gaps yield incomplete. Reviewer semantics are not replaced by host textual inference. [[c1]] [[c4]] [[c5]] [[c6]] [[c9]] [[c13]]

Replace the current unconditional results.length === plan.chunks.length check with two explicit branches. Without impactContext, retain the existing all-fresh exact-coverage invariant. With impactContext, define P as all unique chunk IDs in the complete current plan, S as selected substantive IDs plus all consistency IDs, R as retained current chunk IDs, and F as fresh result chunk IDs. Require unique IDs, S intersect R empty, S union R = P, F = S exactly, and fresh results in the selected executionOrder established by nextDesignUnit. Therefore fresh-result count equals selected executionOrder length, not complete plan length. Require one valid retained origin for every R entry; no consistency chunk may be retained. Unknown, duplicate, missing or overlapping coverage rejects consolidation. [[c5]] [[c6]] [[c1]]

Compute mandatory inventory coverage and effective status/counts from that exact fresh-plus-retained partition and reconciled findings. Do not pad results or report.chunks with copies of retained results: both remain fresh-only, with explicit retained provenance alongside them. Full mode has R empty and S = P, so the same impact branch reduces to the original all-fresh case. [[c5]] [[c1]]

For plan [keep-A, change-B, keep-C, final], fresh results [change-B, final] plus valid retained origins for keep-A and keep-C complete consolidation. The same fresh results without keep-C provenance reject; a retained change-B overlapping fresh change-B rejects; retained final rejects. A freshly re-reviewed chunk that remains incomplete is accepted feedback but keeps the new report incomplete and cannot become reusable verified coverage in a later attempt. [[c5]] [[c6]]

Construct report.impact exactly as the DesignReportImpact schema in §3.4: complete coverageOrigins partition, accepted final findingDecisions, and deduplicated unresolved effectiveFindingOrigins. Require every nested field for an impact attempt, exact equality with accepted sc4/final-output source data where applicable, and valid backward source resolution. Without impactContext omit report.impact and preserve the original all-fresh report contract. Never synthesize retained result bodies to satisfy the old chunks-length invariant. [[c1]] [[c3]] [[c5]] [[c9]]

api.name: validateDesignImpact (proposed sc4-owned internal API)
api.signature: validateDesignImpact(input: unknown, current: DesignAttempt, history: readonly DesignAttempt[]): { plan: DesignChunkPlan; impact: DesignImpactAssessment }

parameters.name: input
parameters.purpose: Untrusted {plan,impact} native candidate or controller impact response payload; decode strict bounded schemas before semantic/provenance validation. This new private validator implements owned sc4; it is not claimed to exist in current code. [[c1]] [[c9]]

parameters.name: current
parameters.purpose: Admitted impact-kind attempt with fresh inventory/baseline and number; supplies current artifact state without re-reading or choosing a new baseline. [[c1]] [[c3]]

parameters.name: history
parameters.purpose: Immutable earlier attempts in this same canonical review, including reviewer metadata and effective coverage. Do not accept history from caller JSON. [[c1]] [[c3]]

returns.meaning: The validated complete current plan and sc4 decision, committed atomically by the existing owner. Pure validation performs no model calls, file edits, persistence or dispatch. [[c1]] [[c5]]

errors.condition: Malformed candidate, unsafe selection/origin/partition, invalid full fallback or declared retention equivalence contradiction. Output failure spends the current impact unit budget, not a new global retry. [[c5]] [[c13]]
Trusted attempt history or identity is corrupt/inconsistent; stop rather than retry a model against invalid host state. [[c3]] [[c13]]

preconditions: current.preparationKind is impact; current has no accepted plan/impact pair, and its current inventory/baseline and immediately preceding terminal complete comparison attempt are pinned. Historical identity and party are host-owned; no baseline is selected by a model-supplied arbitrary number. [[c1]] [[c3]]

Decode a strict {plan,impact} envelope; call existing validateDesignPlan(input.plan,current.inventory) before impact validation. DesignImpactSchema in contracts.ts is the strict bounded schema for the owned HLD sc4 fields; the runtime selection/provenance checks below are not replaced by schema decoding. [[c1]] [[c5]] [[c9]]
postconditions: Validate baselineAttempt against the immediately preceding admitted comparison attempt. Check every current/prior chunk ID against its corresponding plan; mapping rows explain renames, additions/removals and regrouping. Retention requires a one-to-one substantive mapping, matching selectors/concerns and compatible dependencies; the independent reviewer supplies the semantic justification, and host checks structural claims rather than inventing implicit impact. [[c1]] [[c5]]

Partition all current substantive IDs into disjoint direct/indirect selected IDs and retained current IDs; every current inventory unit remains covered through the already validated complete plan. consistencyChunkIds equals all current consistency IDs, including final, and none is retained. Validate unique entries, explanations, backward source resolution, same-party/artifact and finding-origin keys. [[c1]] [[c5]] [[c9]]

Canonical retention eligibility is identical everywhere: source status is passed or changes_requested AND limitations.length === 0. Check every provenance link and the immediately preceding mapped source; incomplete coverage cannot be bypassed through an older passed result. Findings themselves do not make coverage incomplete; unresolved HIGH/MED are carried unless freshly reconciled. [[c1]] [[c5]]

In full mode require no retained coverage and all substantive plus consistency chunks selected. Missing usable comparison context, party mismatch or declared uncertainty requires explicit full-mode rationale; reject affected_chunks output in these cases so the reviewer corrects it under the existing impact retry budget. The host does not silently truncate or invent a semantic selection. [[c1]] [[c13]]

Both native impact candidate and controller phase impact/kind impact invoke this exact validator with the same host-owned context. Only its returned pair can be saved; after acceptance plan and impact are immutable. A later consolidation resolves and rechecks these same source/partition invariants, not a weaker ad hoc test. [[c1]] [[c3]] [[c4]]

api.name: assessDesignResult
api.signature: assessDesignResult(input: unknown, chunk: DesignChunk, previous: readonly DesignChunkResult[], requiredReferences?: readonly string[], impactContext?: { attempt: DesignAttempt; history: readonly DesignAttempt[] }): DesignChunkResult

parameters.name: input
parameters.purpose: Existing untrusted chunk-result boundary decoded against the extended strict DesignResultSchema. [[c5]] [[c9]]

parameters.name: chunk
parameters.purpose: Currently assigned selected chunk, with purpose and ID pinned by the owner. [[c5]]

parameters.name: previous
parameters.purpose: Fresh accepted results in selected execution order for uniqueness and decision evidence checks. [[c5]] [[c6]]

parameters.name: requiredReferences
parameters.purpose: Existing mandatory references/selector coverage; omitted references remain explicit incomplete coverage as today. [[c5]]

parameters.name: impactContext
parameters.purpose: Host-owned accepted impact and immutable history; needed only for impact attempts and finding-decision validation. No caller-provided history is trusted. [[c1]] [[c3]]

returns.meaning: An accepted structurally valid assessment with honest coverage status. No impactContext preserves initial-review validation; report completion still waits for consolidation. [[c5]]

errors.condition: Wrong assigned chunk, duplicate/foreign finding or disposition source, unexpected findingDecisions on a nonfinal chunk, malformed union branch, fabricated superseded finding, or contradictory claimed status. Current-unit output failure follows existing retry rules. [[c5]] [[c9]] [[c13]]
Trusted accepted plan, result order or historical source state is corrupt; stop without model retry. [[c3]] [[c13]]

preconditions: Existing selected chunk/generation and owner fences have already passed. Current plan and impact are accepted and immutable. No result may validate itself against caller-supplied baseline, selection or prior findings. [[c4]] [[c5]]

The findingDecisions field is allowed only for the fresh finalConsistencyChunkId on an impact attempt; a nonfinal or nonimpact submission carrying this field is invalid_result. Each explicit source tuple must identify a baseline effective finding exactly once; bounded branch-specific fields and evidence references are required as specified in the DesignFindingDecision union. [[c1]] [[c5]] [[c9]]
postconditions: For resolved/superseded, validate nonempty reviewedInChunkIds against accepted fresh selected results (or the current final chunk for removed-section consistency), required current evidence, and supersededBy against a current accepted finding. Retained-only chunks cannot provide fresh resolution evidence; those findings carry. Unknown/duplicate origins or invalid branch fields are rejected as invalid_result. [[c1]] [[c5]] [[c9]]

On an impact final chunk with baseline findings, missing findingDecisions or omitted source decisions is a mandatory coverage gap, not permission to remove findings: append pointed limitations, require/normalize incomplete status under existing status rules, and leave the affected origins unresolved for conservative carry at consolidation. No fabricated resolved decision is synthesized. When no baseline findings exist, absent/empty findingDecisions is valid. [[c1]] [[c5]]

A structurally valid incomplete assessment (including missing required references or reconciliation evidence) is accepted without technical retry; all unresolved origins remain carried and the report stays incomplete. Other valid findings and advice retain existing semantics; every limitations entry means mandatory unavailable coverage, while optional execution omissions belong in advice. Native and controller chunk validators call this same function. [[c1]] [[c5]] [[c13]]

api.name: observeDesignCheckpoint
api.signature: observeDesignCheckpoint(checkpoint: DesignReviewCheckpoint, options?: { active?: boolean; liveProgress?: DesignReviewProgress; afterCompletedChunk?: number; includeResult?: boolean }): DesignObservation

parameters.name: checkpoint
parameters.purpose: Existing validated host-owned snapshot. Derive selective counters from accepted plan/impact and fresh results, not a caller-supplied fraction. [[c3]] [[c14]]

parameters.name: options
parameters.purpose: Existing live/stored metadata choice and fresh-result cursor; no model execution or state mutation. [[c14]]

returns.meaning: Bounded existing observation plus optional coverageProgress. completedChunks/totalChunks is the fresh selected fraction; retained coverage is labelled separately. [[c14]]

errors.condition: Cursor is not a safe integer in 0..accepted fresh result count; no change from existing behavior. [[c14]]
Accepted plan/impact/fresh-result counts cannot form the validated selected/retained partition. Observation refuses inconsistent counts; no model retry. [[c3]] [[c6]] [[c13]] [[c14]]

preconditions: No model work or next-attempt admission is triggered by observation. Validate the accepted execution selection and retained origins before deriving counters. [[c1]] [[c6]] [[c14]]
postconditions: For complete plan [keep-A, change-B, keep-C, final] and accepted fresh results [change-B, final], return completedChunks=2,totalChunks=2 and coverageProgress={plannedChunks:4,selectedChunks:2,reviewedChunks:2,retainedChunks:2,effectiveCompletedChunks:4}. After only change-B, return 1/2 with effectiveCompletedChunks=3, not 1/4. A full review reports N/N and retained0. [[c6]] [[c14]]

afterCompletedChunk/nextCompletedChunk page only actual fresh completedResults, one per page as before. alternativesConsidered.name: Attempt-local impact plan with referenced retained coverage
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: One reviewer output supplies the current complete chunk plan plus sc4 scope; unaffected results remain references to immutable prior attempts.
alternativesConsidered.approach: Extend existing checkpoint attempts with a single accepted impact decision and explicit coverage origins. Subsequent completed-review corrections run one impact unit that reads the current document and prior checkpoint paths, proposes the complete current plan and direct/indirect selection, and records conservative full fallback. Fresh results and retained references stay distinct; final consistency reconciles prior findings. Reuse existing checkpoint, validation, activity and recovery services identified in discovery. pros: Smallest complete extension; no copied historical result bodies or new stores.
One current inventory remains fully covered while provenance distinguishes inspected and reused coverage.
Impact analysis and execution share existing recovery and mutation rules.
cons: Scheduler and consolidation must account for coverage references rather than only a completed prefix.
Retaining split/merged chunks needs conservative re-review when one-to-one equivalence cannot be established.

sequenceDefinition.narrative: Explicit correction attempts assess direct and indirect impact, persist selection before execution, and retain prior coverage by reference. The successful path shows fresh final consistency and finding reconciliation; subject mutation at any active stage instead invalidates and requires an approved full restart. Uncertain impact selects full review; every consistency chunk stays fresh. Retained chunks make zero model calls; persist each newly accepted result.
